name: Bambu Lab P1S 0.4 nozzle
extruder_variant_list: Direct Drive Standard,Direct Drive High Flow
machine_start_gcode:
; === Machine start G-code: P1S-0.4 ===
; Original script date: 20250822

; === Hotend and controller cooling ===
M104 S75 ; Set nozzle to 75 C to activate hotend cooling and limit oozing
M710 A1 S255 ; Enable controller board cooling

; === Reset machine state and establish bed clearance ===
M290 X40 Y40 Z2.6666666
G91
M17 Z0.4 ; Reduce Z motor current during clearance moves
G380 S2 Z30 F300 ; Lower the bed to establish nozzle clearance
G380 S2 Z-25 F300
G1 Z5 F300
G90
M17 X1.2 Y1.2 Z0.75 ; Restore default motor currents
M960 S5 P1 ; Turn on the logo light
G90
M220 S100 ; Reset feedrate multiplier
M221 S100 ; Reset flow multiplier
M73.2   R1.0 ; Reset remaining-time multiplier
M1002 set_gcode_claim_speed_level : 5
M221 X0 Y0 Z0 ; Disable software endstops for preparation moves
G29.1 Z{+0.0} ; Clear the Z-offset adjustment
M204 S10000 ; Set initial acceleration to 10000 mm/s^2

; === Heat the bed to the first-layer temperature ===
M1002 gcode_claim_action : 2
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Start heating the bed to the first-layer temperature
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Wait for the bed to reach the first-layer temperature

; === Cooling to reduce PLA heat creep ===
{if filament_type[initial_extruder]=="PLA"}
    {if (bed_temperature[initial_extruder] >45)||(bed_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder] >45)}
        M106 P3 S180
    {endif}
{endif}
M106 P2 S100 ; Turn on auxiliary cooling

; === Prepare nozzle temperature and load filament ===
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; Start heating the nozzle to the first-layer temperature
G91
G0 Z10 F1200
G90
G28 X
{if enable_vibration_compensation}
    M975 S1 ; Enable vibration compensation
{endif}
G1 X60 F12000
G1 Y245
G1 Y265 F3000
M620 M
M620 S[initial_extruder]A ; Select the initial filament when AMS is available
    M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
    G1 X120 F12000

    G1 X20 Y50 F12000
    G1 Y-3
    T[initial_extruder]
    G1 X54 F12000
    G1 Y265
    M400
M621 S[initial_extruder]A
M620.1 E F{flush_volumetric_speeds[initial_no_support_extruder]/2.4053*60} T{flush_temperatures[initial_no_support_extruder]}

; === Flush filament and remove purge waste ===
M412 S1 ; Enable filament runout detection

M109 S250 ; Wait for the nozzle to reach the 250 C flushing temperature
M106 P1 S0
G92 E0
G1 E50 F200
M400
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
G92 E0
G1 E50 F200
M400
M106 P1 S255
G92 E0
G1 E5 F300
M109 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]-20} ; Wait for the nozzle to cool to 20 C below the first-layer temperature
G92 E0
G1 E-0.5 F300

G1 X70 F9000
G1 X76 F15000
G1 X65 F15000
G1 X76 F15000
G1 X65 F15000 ; Shake off purged filament
G1 X80 F6000
G1 X95 F15000
G1 X80 F15000
G1 X165 F15000 ; Wipe and shake off remaining filament
M400
M106 P1 S0

; === Nozzle wiping and cleaning ===
M1002 gcode_claim_action : 14
{if enable_vibration_compensation}
    M975 S1
{endif}
M106 S255
G1 X65 Y230 F18000
G1 Y264 F6000
M109 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]-20}
G1 X100 F18000 ; First nozzle wipe

G0 X135 Y253 F20000 ; Move to the edge of the exposed steel cleaning area
G28 Z P0 T300 ; Home Z at low precision, allowing a nozzle temperature up to 300 C
G29.2 S0 ; Disable bed leveling compensation
G0 Z5 F20000

G1 X60 Y265
G92 E0
G1 E-0.5 F300 ; Retract an additional 0.5 mm
G1 X100 F5000 ; Repeat nozzle wiping passes
G1 X70 F15000
G1 X100 F5000
G1 X70 F15000
G1 X100 F5000
G1 X70 F15000
G1 X100 F5000
G1 X70 F15000
G1 X90 F5000
G0 X128 Y261 Z-1.5 F20000 ; Position the nozzle against the exposed steel cleaning area
M104 S140 ; Set nozzle temperature to 140 C for contact cleaning
M106 S255 ; Restore cooling after homing

; Scrub the exposed steel cleaning area, then finish with circular passes.
M221 S ; Save software endstop state
M221 Z0 ; Disable the Z software endstop for cleaning
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y259.5 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y262.5
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y260.0
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y262.0
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y260.5
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y261.5
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y261.0
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 X128
G2 I0.5 J0 F300
G2 I0.5 J0 F300
G2 I0.5 J0 F300
G2 I0.5 J0 F300

M109 S140 ; Wait for the nozzle to cool to 140 C
G2 I0.5 J0 F3000
G2 I0.5 J0 F3000
G2 I0.5 J0 F3000
G2 I0.5 J0 F3000

M221 R ; Restore software endstop state
G1 Z10 F1200
M400
G1 Z10
G1 F30000
G1 X230 Y15
G29.2 S1 ; Enable bed leveling compensation
;G28 ; Optional additional homing after contact cleaning (disabled)
M106 S0 ; Turn off part cooling after cleaning

; === Optional bed leveling ===
M1002 judge_flag g29_before_print_flag
M622 J1
    M1002 gcode_claim_action : 1
    G29 A X{first_layer_print_min[0]} Y{first_layer_print_min[1]} I{first_layer_print_size[0]} J{first_layer_print_size[1]}
    M400
    M500 ; Save bed leveling calibration
M623

; === Home after cleaning when bed leveling is skipped ===
M1002 judge_flag g29_before_print_flag
M622 J0
    M1002 gcode_claim_action : 13
    G28
M623

{if enable_vibration_compensation}
    M975 S1 ; Enable vibration compensation
{endif}

; === Cooling to reduce PLA heat creep ===
{if filament_type[initial_extruder]=="PLA"}
    {if (bed_temperature[initial_extruder] >45)||(bed_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder] >45)}
        M106 P3 S180
    {endif}
{endif}
M106 P2 S100 ; Turn on auxiliary cooling

M104 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]} ; Start reheating the nozzle while preparation continues

; === Optional vibration compensation check ===
{if enable_vibration_compensation}
    G1 X128 Y128 Z10 F20000
    M400 P200
    M970.3 Q1 A7 B30 C80  H15 K0
    M974 Q1 S2 P0

    G1 X128 Y128 Z10 F20000
    M400 P200
    M970.3 Q0 A7 B30 C90 Q0 H15 K0
    M974 Q0 S2 P0

    M975 S1
    G1 F30000
    G1 X230 Y15
    G28 X ; Home X again after the vibration check
{endif}

; === Prime the nozzle with a purge line ===
{if enable_vibration_compensation}
    M975 S1
{endif}
G90
M83
T1000
G1 X18.0 Y1.0 Z0.8 F18000 ; Move to the purge-line start position
M109 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]}
G1 Z0.2
G0 E2 F300
G0 X240 E15 F{outer_wall_volumetric_speed/(0.3*0.5)     * 60}
G0 Y11 E0.700 F{outer_wall_volumetric_speed/(0.3*0.5)/ 4 * 60}
G0 X239.5
G0 E0.2
G0 Y1.5 E0.700
G0 X18 E15 F{outer_wall_volumetric_speed/(0.3*0.5)     * 60}
M400

; === Textured PEI plate Z-offset adjustment ===
;curr_bed_type={curr_bed_type}
{if curr_bed_type=="Textured PEI Plate"}
    G29.1 Z{-0.04} ; Lower the nozzle by 0.04 mm to account for the textured surface
{endif}

; === Finish preparation and turn off cooling fans ===
M1002 gcode_claim_action : 0
M106 S0 ; Turn off part cooling
M106 P2 S0 ; Turn off auxiliary cooling
M106 P3 S0 ; Turn off chamber cooling

{if enable_vibration_compensation}
    M975 S1 ; Enable vibration compensation
{endif}
machine_end_gcode:
; === Machine end G-code: P1S (shared by all nozzle sizes) ===
; Original script date: 20230428

; === Retract filament and move to the rear purge area ===
M400 ; Wait for queued moves to finish
G92 E0 ; Reset the extruder position
G1 E-0.8 F1800 ; Retract 0.8 mm of filament
G1 Z{max_layer_z + 0.5} F900 ; Lower the bed for 0.5 mm of clearance above the print
G1 X65 Y245 F12000 ; Move toward the rear purge area
G1 Y265 F3000

; === Turn off bed heating and cooling fans ===
G1 X65 Y245 F12000
G1 Y265 F3000
M140 S0 ; Turn off bed heating
M106 S0 ; Turn off part cooling
M106 P2 S0 ; Turn off auxiliary cooling
M106 P3 S0 ; Turn off chamber cooling

; === Wipe the nozzle and return filament to the AMS ===
G1 X100 F12000 ; Wipe the nozzle
M620 S255
    G1 X20 Y50 F12000
    G1 Y-3
    T255
    G1 X65 F12000
    G1 Y265
    G1 X100 F12000 ; Wipe the nozzle after unloading
M621 S255
M104 S0 ; Turn off nozzle heating

; === Finish timelapse recording when enabled ===
M622.1 S1 ; Enable conditional execution by default for older firmware
M1002 judge_flag timelapse_record_flag
M622 J1
    M400 ; Wait for queued moves to finish
    M991 S0 P-1 ; End smooth timelapse at the parked position
    M400 S3 ; Wait 3 seconds for the final picture
M623

; === Lower the bed for print removal ===
M400 ; Wait for queued moves to finish
M17 S ; Save motor current settings
M17 Z0.4 ; Reduce Z motor current during bed lowering
; Lower up to 100 mm beyond the print height, capped at Z250, then raise 2 mm.
{if (max_layer_z + 100.0) < 250}
    G1 Z{max_layer_z + 100.0} F600
    G1 Z{max_layer_z +98.0}
{else}
    G1 Z250 F600
    G1 Z248
{endif}
M400 P100 ; Wait for queued moves to finish and pause for 100 ms
M17 R ; Restore saved motor current settings

; === Reset speed and timing multipliers ===
M220 S100 ; Reset feedrate multiplier
M201.2 K1.0 ; Reset acceleration multiplier
M73.2   R1.0 ; Reset remaining-time multiplier
M1002 set_gcode_claim_speed_level : 0

; === Reduce motor currents for idle ===
M17 X0.8 Y0.8 Z0.5 ; Set idle motor currents for X, Y, and Z
time_lapse_gcode:
; === Timelapse layer-change G-code: P1S ===
; SKIPPABLE_START
; SKIPTYPE: timelapse
M622.1 S1 ; Enable conditional execution by default for older firmware
M1002 judge_flag timelapse_record_flag
M622 J1
{if timelapse_type == 0} ; Timelapse without wipe tower
    M971 S11 C10 O0
    M1004 S5 P1 ; Trigger external shutter
{elsif timelapse_type == 1} ; Timelapse with wipe tower
    G92 E0 ; Reset extruder position
    G1 X65 Y245 F20000 ; Move to the rear safe position
    G17 ; Select the XY plane for arc movement
    G2 Z{layer_z} I0.86 J0.86 P1 F20000
    G1 Y265 F3000
    M400 ; Wait for queued moves to finish
    M1004 S5 P1 ; Trigger external shutter
    M400 P300 ; Pause for 300 ms
    M971 S11 C11 O0
    G92 E0 ; Reset extruder position
    G1 X100 F5000
    G1 Y255 F20000
{endif}
M623
; SKIPPABLE_END
